item.title: AVM Image Quality Enhancement by Synthetic Image Learning for Supervised Deblurring
item.description: An Around View Monitoring (AVM) system is widely used to allow a driver to watch the situation around a car. The AVM image is generated by image distortion correction and viewpoint transformation for images captured by wide view-angle cameras installed on the car. However, the AVM image is blurred due to these transformations. This blur impairs the visibility of the driver. While many deblurring methods based on CNN have been proposed, these general-purpose de-blurring methods are not designed for the AVM image.
